summary: A Google DeepMind researcher announces the launch of the Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber model paired with the Code Mender harness, aimed at helping software defense teams find and secure vulnerabilities in production systems.

practices.reason: A cyber-specialized model variant combined with a tool harness is relevant if a team runs vulnerability-detection or secure-coding workflows, but no benchmark or gain figure is given.
practices.quote: By combining Gemini Cyber with the Code Mender harness, we're giving frontline software defense teams a head start to efficiently uncover and secure critical vulnerabilities in complex production systems.

practices.reason: Combining a model with a harness for automated vulnerability discovery/repair is an orchestration pattern, but the mechanics and gains are not described concretely enough to implement.
